messages:
tom_partnerships: Quick preflight — Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant joint demo at partner HQ next Wed. Who owns infra, data snapshot, marketplace assets, and the go/no-go? Need decision by EOD Tue.

maria_pm: I can own the demo data snapshot (redwood-demo:synth-v2). ETA Mon EOD. Will mark it as synthetic-only for legal.

lee_eng: I'll provision DGX + NVMe nodes for the onprem Qdrant run. Need exact vector dims and schema from @maria_pm. Also want to confirm network path to Snowflake stage.

aj_devrel: I'll draft the demo script + sample prompts. Need a pinned model for partners — which model should we lock for the demo (production-stable vs canary)?

olga_si: SI asks for a runbook and service account. Legal also requested a brief privacy checklist for the dataset. Can someone share IAM least-privileges?

sarah_sales: Sales requests an embargoed joint announcement. Proposed embargo: Thurs 12pm PT. Can marketing + partnerships align?

maria_pm: On model: research approved pin prod-ct-2026-05 v3-quant for external demos. I'll confirm in the model registry and post the model_id.

lee_eng: For Qdrant: float32 vectors, dim=1536. Snowflake ingest pipeline will COPY from an internal stage. Example SQL snippet I used in dev: 
```sql
-- ingest to internal stage
COPY INTO @redwood_stage/embeds
FROM (SELECT id, embed FROM demo_table);
```

tom_partnerships: @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary deploy for the demo route on dedicated cluster and set fallback to hosted API? We want auto-failover if onprem network flaps.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary created: canary/demo-route -> dedicated-1 with fallback to hosted-api. Job queued.

aj_devrel: Marketplace assets needed: logo (svg), short blurb, and completed security questionnaire. Marketing handoff by Tue noon please. I can draft the blurb.

sarah_sales: I have a draft partner comms PR, will paste the link in #partnerships-docs and ping partners for approval.

olga_si: For the SI runbook we need a minimal Terraform + IAM snippet. Can someone paste a minimal example?

lee_eng: IAM snippet (minimal): 
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "redwood_demo_connector" {
  name = "redwood-demo-connector"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assume.json
}
```
Permissions: S3 read for stage, Snowflake user for COPY, and KMS decrypt for model key.

maria_pm: Privacy: dataset is synthetic, but legal wants a DPIA-attestation doc. I'll file a request with #compliance and attach the attestation by Mon noon.

tom_partnerships: Risk note: latency from onprem DGX -> Snowflake stage could spike during demo. Plan B: pre-warm KV cache and increase TTL; also have pre-generated compressed responses to serve if KV falls back.

aj_devrel: Agree. Also let's schedule a dry-run with partner engineer Fri 10am PT. Can folks confirm availability?

maria_pm: I can make Fri 10am.

lee_eng: I'll join Fri 10am and bring logs for the DGX network test.

olga_si: SI will attend Fri 10am to validate connector auth flow.

sarah_sales: I'll be on the call for partner comms timing.

tom_partnerships: Great — if we have no blockers by Tue EOD we greenlight. Please post any blockers in thread. :thumbsup:

maria_pm: No blockers from data side currently.

lee_eng: One potential blocker: NVMe nodes delivery for DGX test might slip to Tue evening. I'll update if ETA changes.

aj_devrel: I'll upgrade the demo script to include fallback steps and share v1 by Wed morning.

olga_si: Request: share final runbook in this thread before Tue EOD so SI can run through it ahead of Fri.

tom_partnerships: Will compile checklist and tag owners in a single message Mon AM. Thanks all. :rocket:
